warranty_program.excludes: Damage from heat, impact, chemicals, improper use
warranty_program.summary: Lifetime transferable residential warranty. Strong on paper but corporate instability raises warranty-backing risk.

service_network.summary: Adequate dealer network but corporate instability could affect long-term support.

company_stability.manufacturing: 100% outsourced as of Dec 2025 — Bar-Lev plant closed. Previously had facilities in Israel and Georgia, USA.
company_stability.financial_health: Major distress — 2025 revenue $397M (down from $443M), net loss $137.5M, 618 silicosis claims ($47.2M provision), stock $1.22 (March 2026)

reputation_pattern.fabricator_consensus: Strong product quality historically. Corporate situation is the concern, not the material.
